title: Peggy Lee gets him singing
summary: Peggy Lee heard him sing on a Vegas trip and encouraged him.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: I started singing... Peggy Lee got me started singing, the first time I went out with her in Vegas. I don't know why, but we used to go to this one place that stayed open late, and I knew the lyrics to some songs that she didn't know. "Some Other Spring" and "Pretty Eyes". She wound up making an album called Pretty Eyes. And she just thought I sang great. "Sing some more!" Sing some
more! I never sang in my life!
